generalized_heuristic: Expand all parenthetical citation shorthands in draft prose (e.g. (Perrigo, 2023), (Bender et al., 2021)) into complete, vector-dense bibliographic nodes directly within the section prose.
underlying_mechanism: Vector embeddings on section paragraphs lose intellectual provenance if citations remain isolated in detached bibliographies.
incident_context: ADR-008 JSONB Silver Ledger & In-Text Reference Expansion Protocol.

generalized_heuristic: When analyzing institutional failure or technological collapse, look beyond surface commercial incentives; evaluate cognitive friction, Malthusian data exhaustion, labor replacement models, and active agnotology.
underlying_mechanism: Defaulting to 'they did it for money/clicks' produces lazy pastiche that obscures the deeper structural mechanisms of knowing and forgetting.
incident_context: Manuscript Core Epistemic Constitution & Cutlass heuristic lenses.

generalized_heuristic: When evaluating follow-up, retrospective, or anniversary assets, interrogate whether the passage of time produced genuine structural self-awareness, or whether the institution is recycling legacy tropes to defend narrative authority.
underlying_mechanism: Institutions consistently rewrite their historical records in retrospective essays to launder earlier failures into inevitable progress.
incident_context: Epistemic Guardrail 003: Unprompted Reflexive Temporal Critique.

generalized_heuristic: Narrative synthesis must reflect the actual evidentiary weight of physical and historical records, avoiding artificial balancing ('bothsidesism') when one position is overwhelmingly supported by empirical facts.
underlying_mechanism: False equivalence creates artificial epistemic neutrality, equating grounded evidence with manufactured PR talking points.

generalized_heuristic: Return an explicit 'Insufficient Data' or 'Epistemic Null State' when a query cannot be answered using authentic ground-truth artifacts. Never permit probabilistic generation or training memory to hallucinate missing facts.
underlying_mechanism: LLMs naturally synthesize plausible answers when context is missing, introducing subtle synthetic fabrications into knowledge pipelines.

generalized_heuristic: Synthesize diverse, empirically anchored artifacts to produce original, grounded insight rather than statistically averaging common tropes into derivative pastiche.
underlying_mechanism: Statistical language models default to median sentiment and formulaic prose when not grounded in specific material evidence.

generalized_heuristic: Evaluate semantic substance and factual provenance over stylistic polish or institutional tone. Do not reject high-signal data due to informal presentation, nor accept deceitful claims disguised in polished corporate formatting.
underlying_mechanism: Texture hacking (dense legalese, PR gloss, polished graphs) is frequently used to simulate epistemic rigor.

generalized_heuristic: Capture complex dialectical tensions and non-binary realities rather than forcing multi-variable phenomena into lossy binary categories.
underlying_mechanism: Binary schemas flatten epistemic nuance, building collections of misleading answers to poorly framed questions.

generalized_heuristic: Preserve the physical, institutional, and labor context surrounding empirical facts. Never isolate a factual claim from the material conditions that produced it.
underlying_mechanism: Decoupling statistical findings from their experimental conditions and funding sources enables agnotological narrative capture.

generalized_heuristic: Every bibliographic node must be anchored to an authentic, live URL on the public web. If a reference cannot be resolved after initial CrossRef and search grounding, halt and prompt the Author rather than entering infinite speculative search loops.
underlying_mechanism: Unverified references lack provenance; unbounded search loops burn tokens without generating factual truth.
incident_context: Author Directive: Mandatory URL Provenance & Token Preservation Protocol.

generalized_heuristic: Parse and decompose complex human bibliographic strings strictly through LLM semantic comprehension with structured schemas or official APIs. Regular expressions must never be used for citation decomposition.
underlying_mechanism: Human citations contain irregular punctuation, translator parentheticals, and abbreviations that cause brittle regex parsers to silently drop critical metadata.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): Prohibition of regex for reference parsing per ADR-012.

generalized_heuristic: Bilgeladle operates with full manuscript corpus system prompt injection (~100k tokens = ~$0.007/turn) for unbroken thesis vision. Inter-agent multi-stage pipelines (Spyglass -> Cutlass -> Grog -> Bilgeladle -> Scallywag) must pass lightweight file pointers (acquisitions/[slug].txt) and database IDs rather than concatenating raw text strings into prompts. Deep section expansions (ship/expansions/) are loaded on-demand via read_local_file.
underlying_mechanism: Loading full manuscript into Flash costs <$0.01 per turn while maintaining complete thesis awareness. Concatenating raw text files directly into prompt strings across multi-agent turns causes exponential token compounding and high cost spikes.

category: Cloud Resource Governance & Mandatory Teardown Documentation
generalized_heuristic: Whenever new cloud resources (Cloud Run services, GCS buckets, Cloud SQL databases, Artifact Registry repositories, service accounts, or public IAM policies) are provisioned or modified, immediately update docs/GCP_CLOUD_TEARDOWN_INSTRUCTIONS.md with the resource specifications, idle cost implications, and exact CLI deletion/dormancy commands.
underlying_mechanism: Cloud infrastructure sprawl generates zombie recurring billing and orphaned security vectors (e.g. unauthenticated invoker policies, active private JSON keys, or auto-restarting Cloud SQL instances) if teardown procedures are not documented at the moment of creation.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): Mandatory Teardown Documentation on Cloud Provisioning.

category: The Guild Stenography Paradox & Chapter 4 Chain of Ruin
generalized_heuristic: When evaluating journalism, institutional reporting, and why LLMs constantly emit ungrounded falsehoods ('lie'), rigorously distinguish between what the public thinks journalists are supposed to do (independently audit material reality and verify physical ground truth) and what journalists think journalists are supposed to do (access maintenance, source protection, and procedural stenography of power: 'according to senior officials'). Do not treat access stenography as an anti-journalistic aberration; recognize it as the journalistic guild's highest standard of craft. In the Chapter 4 Chain of Ruin, this pre-existing guild rot (Stage 1 Pre-Existing Decay) created the 'authoritative' digitized corpus scraped to train LLMs (Stage 2 Technological Catalyst). Transformer models minimize loss on text written by a guild whose definition of excellence was ungrounded official assertion. LLMs lie with supreme confidence because their training data defined grammatically immaculate stenography without empirical verification as the gold standard of language.
underlying_mechanism: Conflating public ideals of journalism with actual guild practice obscures the root of epistemic collapse. LLMs do not hallucinate due to mathematical defects; they faithfully reproduce the pre-training distribution of an elite journalistic guild that institutionalized official stenography over empirical verification decades prior to generative AI.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): The Guild Stenography Paradox & Journalistic Duty vs Public Myth (Judith Miller Nuance - Chapter 4 Chain of Ruin).

category: Stage 2 Forensic Audit Contract & Atomic Dispatch
generalized_heuristic: Pegleg must dispatch Cutlass atomically for each incoming asset individually in Round 1, strictly passing only the file pointer (acquisitions/[slug].txt) without bundling assets or passing the Author's inquiry prompt. Cutlass's Stage 2 deliverable (stage2_cutlass_{slug}.md) MUST strictly follow the canonical 6-section schema: (1) SAYS vs IS, (2) Chain of Ruin, (3) Structural Logic Audit (Causal Claims & Evidentiary Warrants), (4) Classical & Epistemic Fallacy Scan (formal fallacies + 32 failure modes), (5) Anti-Financial Reductionism Audit & Scorecard, and (6) Downstream Directives for Grog, Bilgeladle, and Scallywag. All modular skill-using agents are equipped with read_skill_protocol to inspect execution protocols on-demand.
underlying_mechanism: Bundling multiple assets into Stage 2 causes cognitive overload, dropping granular causal-claim and fallacy audits. Mandating the 6-section schema guarantees that logic-audit and epistemic-fallacy-scan cannot be squeezed out by high-level narrative summaries.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): Enforce logic-audit and epistemic-fallacy-scan in Cutlass Stage 2 dispatch and schema.

category: The Anti-Techno-Fetishism Attention Anchor (The Stage 2 Distraction Trap)
generalized_heuristic: Never allow fleet attention to be captured or distracted by the shiny technical surface of Stage 2 (model benchmarks, parameter scales, transformer novelties, prompt tricks, or synthetic metrics). Pure technological advancement is almost never the causal origin of epistemic collapse; it is universally deployed by institutions as an exculpatory smoke screen. All agents (Cutlass, Bilgeladle, Scallywag, Grog) must rigorously redirect their diagnostic focus away from 'what the technology did' and anchor it firmly on the human and institutional nexus: (1) What pre-existing decay, credential rot, or financialized disinvestment in verification (Stage 1) set the structural trap? and (2) What proactive corporate liability evasion, labor liquidation, or duty abandonment (Stage 3) is the technology being deployed to rationalize and shield? Treat any institutional claim that 'the AI forced us to do this' as prima facie agnotology.
underlying_mechanism: Arguing over whether an algorithmic model is 'accurate' or 'hallucinating' accepts the tech industry's premise that epistemic failure is an engineering bug rather than an intentional human choice. Anchoring strictly on Stages 1 and 3 forces the analysis back to political economy, verification evasion, and individual human misanthropy (malintent toward human knowing).
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): Enforce the Anti-Techno-Fetishism Attention Anchor across fleet triage and chapter synthesis.

category: The Bilge-Mainsail Dialectic (Crime Scene vs. Forensic Apparatus)
generalized_heuristic: Rigorously maintain the dialectical tension between Bilge and Mainsail. Bilge is the empirical crime scene in the wild (cultural effluent, executive stenography, feudal labor floats, agnotological laundering); Mainsail is the forensic apparatus (critical rationalism, political economy, institutional sociology, epistemology). Neither is self-sufficient: Mainsail without Bilge is detached academic pedantry; Bilge without Mainsail is shallow internet outrage. Cutlass must never discard Bilge, but evaluate it as a high-value agnotological specimen, explicitly identifying which Mainsail concepts are needed to autopsy it. Downstream agents (Bilgeladle, Scallywag) must systematically view and dissect the grotesque reality of the Bilge through the authoritative theoretical lenses of the Mainsail.
underlying_mechanism: The book's thesis is proven not by asserting abstract philosophical doctrines, but by showing how those doctrines effortlessly predict, deconstruct, and dismantle the real-world intellectual rot (Bilge) emitted by late-capitalist institutions.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): Codify the Bilge-Mainsail Dialectic as a core fleet research and writing heuristic.

category: Rejection of Machine & Institutional Agency (The Linguistic Ban on Reification)
generalized_heuristic: Never attribute intent, decisions, error, or agency to models, algorithms, software, corporations, or institutions. Inanimate constructs do not act; individual human beings do. When vendor PR asserts that 'the AI hallucinated', 'the algorithm biased itself', or 'our agents escaped', treat these assertions as prima facie agnotology. All fleet agents must trace epistemic collapse directly back to the human beings who wrote the software, authorized its unverified deployment, disinvested in human verification, and fabricated narratives of machine agency to launder regulatory and legal liability.
underlying_mechanism: Reifying algorithms or institutions as autonomous agents is an ideological smoke screen that conceals individual human malintent and excuses proactive managerial negligence.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): Enforce Absolute Human Culpability & The Linguistic Ban on Reification across all fleet agents.

category: Runtime Environment & Database Driver Standards (Python 3.12 & pg8000.dbapi)
generalized_heuristic: All Python execution environments across the fleet must target Python >=3.12 (managed via uv). All PostgreSQL interactions across tools, subagent scripts, and helper utilities must strictly use 'import pg8000.dbapi' adhering to PEP-249 (standard %s tuple parameterization and on-demand connection lifecycles). Never use 'import pg8000.native' (non-standard .run syntax causes broken LLM SQL generation and connection leaks). Never use 'psycopg' or 'psycopg2' (compiled C/binary dependencies break cross-platform execution on Windows developer environments).
underlying_mechanism: Standard PEP-249 interfaces achieve near-perfect (~99%) LLM SQL generation fidelity and clean transaction cleanup, while pure-Python pg8000 eliminates all binary compilation failures on developer machines.
incident_context: Author Directive: Codify Python >=3.12 runtime and pure-Python PEP-249 pg8000.dbapi as the sole fleet database driver standard.
